description: EF.UST marks 5GS services available but not service 124 (Subscription identifier privacy support), so the card offers no SUCI configuration
remediation: if the operator uses SUPI concealment, set service 124 in EF.UST and provision EF.SUCI_Calc_Info (or set 125 for USIM calculation); otherwise confirm the terminal is configured to conceal the SUPI, then re-scan
